_about: Public-domain John L. Girardeau (1825-1898, Southern Presbyterian, Columbia Theological Seminary) for the Word Hoard: Calvinism and Evangelical Arminianism (1890), The Will in its Theological Relations (1891), Instrumental Music in the Public Worship of the Church (1888), the posthumous Discussions of Philosophical Questions (1900), Discussions of Theological Questions (1905) and Sermons (1907), all edited by George A. Blackburn, and three early addresses and sermons (1858-1874), raw Internet Archive OCR. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 18 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
